Name: Express Mail
Author: DaTravBoo
Description:
[heading]📦 ExpressMail[/heading]
A simple, quality-of-life Stardew Valley mod that lets you browse and advance through your entire mailbox queue seamlessly without having to close and reopen the mailbox every single time.

✨ Features
[list]
[*][b]Quick Mail Navigation:[/b] Adds a forward arrow to the letter viewer menu so you can cycle through all your unread mail back-to-back.[/*]
[*][b]Lightweight & Clean:[/b] Built for smooth compatibility with Stardew Valley 1.6.[/*]
[/list]⚠️ Known Issues
[list]
[*][b]Uncollected Rewards:[/b] If a letter contains an attached item or money reward and you use the forward arrow to skip past it [b]without collecting the item first[/b], you will miss/lose that reward. Make sure to grab your attachments before clicking to the next letter![/*]
[/list]
📦 Installation
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
[/*]
[*]Unzip the
[code]ExpressMail[/code]folder into your
[code]Stardew Valley\Mods[/code]directory.
[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI![/*]
[/list]
